audit_items.proof_trace: Every reward-claim path requires an `ObligationOwnerCap` whose `obligation_id` (set immutably at cap creation via `object::id(&obligation)`) is used to look up per-obligation rewards. The cap struct can only be constructed by `protocol::obligation::new()` (marked `public(package)`), preventing forgery. Sui's VM enforces that only the cap's current owner can submit it as a transaction input, so reward claims are restricted to the cap holder.
